title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Exceptions and Exclusions
summary: This document lists merchants that are excluded from cash back on the Business Bronze Rewards Card, including 0% cash back for WeWork, Regus, Industrious, Gusto, ADP, Paychex, and Rippling. It also states SaaS merchants (Slack, Zoom, HubSpot, Salesforce) earn 1.0% for the first 12 months only; after that, auto-renewals/continued subscription payments earn 0%.
